name: YouTube Transcript
description: Third-party hosted REST API (TranscriptAPI.com) for extracting YouTube video transcripts plus search, channel and playlist data; not YouTube's official API.
access_notes: Self-serve signup at transcriptapi.com grants 100 free credits with no credit card; ongoing use requires a paid subscription from $5/month for 1,000 credits (1 credit per successful request, some endpoints free).
mcp_notes: Vendor advertises a native YouTube MCP server; 'MCP Access' is included in all paid plans on the pricing page. No Composio toolkit for TranscriptAPI found (docs.composio.dev/toolkits/youtube_transcript returns 404; Composio's YouTube toolkit targets Google's official YouTube API, a different service).
uncertainty_notes: API is read-only by nature (transcript/search/channel/playlist retrieval), which is the product's entire scope, so verdict is buildable_now despite narrow breadth. No webhook documentation found in the API reference; left null. Researched transcriptapi.com per the assignment hint, not YouTube's official Data API.

evidence.note: 'The API uses Bearer token authentication. Include your API key in the Authorization header'; endpoint table: /youtube/transcript, /search, /channel/*, /playlist/videos under api/v2
'Get transcripts, search videos, browse channels, and extract playlists via REST API or YouTube MCP'; plans from $5/month with MCP Access and API Access; free API key at signup
Vendor tutorial: 'the free tier gives you 100 credits'; sign up, grab API key from dashboard, Bearer header
